newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts mired below 114-00 resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts mired below 114-00 resistance.

text.p: September gilt futures traded on LIFFE look mildly bullish from a technical perspective, but will find a block of resistance below 114-00 hard to overcome, technical analysts said on Friday.
"Yesterday's high at 113-25 is the first resistance, backed up by 113-27, a high from earlier in the week," said Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.
"Above there, 114-00 is the key level, opening the way for a retest of the year's high."
September gilt futures hit a high of 114-31 on May 9. The contract was trading up 1/32 at 113-15 at 0700 GMT.

Analysts said gilts face a difficult day ahead of an announcement on UK interest rates due at 1100 GMT. The market consensus is for a quarter-point rise in base rates, although many commentators disagree.
"Opinion is divided, which probably means that gilts will not move sharply either way," said Cossor. "The U.S. nonfarm payrolls are more important."

Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures said there seems no sign of an end to the current sideways action, with very strong support around 113-00, and significant supply around 113-30.

Cossor said a retest of the 113-00 level, the June 4 low, was possible. But even if the market broke down through there, then it would have to confront minor support from hourly charts at 112-26, and below there hourly congestion down to 112-and-a-half.
A trader at a British bank said there was support at 113-10, drawn from a trendline at the May 28 low of 112-05. He cited resistance at 113-26.
Analysts said stochastics on the September short sterling chart continues to trace out a bullish formation. September short sterling was unchanged at 93.17.
